mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing metoprolol levels, while also possessing antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that could potentiate bleeding risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; adjust metoprolol dose if needed; counsel patient on bleeding precautions and consistent turmeric intake to avoid fluctuating drug levels.
